messages:
Mira Chen: quick update — ran hybrid speculative-queueing on quantized-70b candidate (int4 + KV warmup) across our 3 workload slices, results look promising for latency but some odd quality deltas.
Samir Patel: can you share the config and key metrics?
Mira Chen: sure — short version: spec_policy=hybrid, prefetch_window=16, queue_depth=4, kv_warmup=true, batch_size=8. 2x median token throughput, p50 tok latency down ~35%.
Jia Nguyen: nice for latency. what quality metrics?
Mira Chen: automated metrics: ppl +1.8 on the held-out dialog set, embed-sim drop ~0.9%, and a small bump in factuality regressions (~2.3% -> 3.9%) on the KB-check tests. human spot check found more terse completions in longform where speculative stitch happened.
Derek Liu: do we see any correlation with prompt length or turn count?
Mira Chen: yes — regressions concentrate on >512 token contexts and when the prefix has many code blocks. suspect prefetch window overlaps stale KV with newer context.
Samir Patel: can we reproduce in non-quantized float16 to isolate quantization vs speculative protocol?
Mira Chen: ran that — float16 + hybrid speculative gave similar latency gains but smaller quality delta (ppl +0.4). so quantization amplifies sensitivity.
Jia Nguyen: sounds like two factors: quant noise + speculative cache inconsistency. what's EvalBot saying?
EvalBot: automated-run: hybrid-spec-queue v1.3 | runs=1200 | p50_latency=44ms | p95_latency=120ms | ppl_holdout=18.2 (baseline 16.4) | factual_fail_rate=3.9%
Samir Patel: thanks. suggested next steps?
Mira Chen: proposed plan: (1) add strict KV freshness check for >512 contexts (fast path bypass) (2) rerun quantized runs with adjusted prefetch_window=8, queue_depth=2 (3) run pairwise human eval on 200 examples targeted at long-context QA and code synthesis.
Derek Liu: also add rollout safety: canary 1% traffic on dedicated pool with fallback to non-spec model on quality SLA breach.
Jia Nguyen: can we get quick metric to gate? maybe fail if factual_fail_rate > 2.5% increase vs baseline or if embed-sim drops >1.5%.
Mira Chen: agreed. gate thresholds noted. I'll push a config patch. snippet for the experiment controller:
```
exp: hybrid-queue-v2
precompute_kv_freshness: true
prefetch_window: 8
queue_depth: 2
quant_mode: int4
fallback_policy: immediate-on-sla-fail
```
Samir Patel: add log hooks for token-level alignment when stitch happens — we need traces where speculative path diverged.
Mira Chen: will add token-level diff logs and a span tag `spec_fallback=true/false`. also will label examples for human eval: 100 longform QA, 100 code-gen.
EvalBot: queued human-eval job id=HE-2026-09 | 200 examples | annotators=3 | estimated=18h
ops-bot: created canary deployment redwood-dedicated/queue-hybrid-v2 -> traffic=1% | rollback_on_metric=eval_gate
Jia Nguyen: timeline?
Mira Chen: config patch + rerun quantized sims by EOD tomorrow, canary early next week depending on results. will post updated metrics here.
Samir Patel: thanks — appreciate the fast loop. :thumbsup:
